1636-5900.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap for at least enough mana to activate your blink effect.
1636-5900.description:
Activate all mana-producing creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to activate Lilysplash Mentor.
Pay the mana cost to activate Lilysplash Mentor's ability, exiling another creature you control and returning it to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter.
Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
1636-5900.notes: If your creatures generate more mana than is necessary for the loop, this results in infinite mana.

719-5412-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
719-5412-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Xenograft, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Coastal Hornclaw by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Xenograft, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Coastal Hornclaw ability, giving it flying until end of turn.
Repeat from step 3.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-3249-4289-6244--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3249-4289-6244--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Cryptolith Rite by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Cryptolith Rite by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the creature castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature spell from your graveyard by paying it mana cost.
When you cast that creature or when it enters, Saradoc triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

856-1379-3899-6748-6757.description:
Cast Cauldron Familiar by paying {B}.
When Cauldron Familiar enters, it and Weapons Manufacturing trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Weapons Manufacturing trigger, creating a Munitions artifact token.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing the Munitions, as it is a Food due to Ragost.
The Munitions triggers, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

222-527-1251-8095.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-1251-8095.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Hammerhead twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

851-4772-5478-6753-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Spelunking.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat
851-4772-5478-6753-7942.notes: An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

2724-3080-4608-7843.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four enchantments.
2724-3080-4608-7843.description:
Cast Exchange of Words by paying {1}{U}{U}.
When Exchange of Words enters, it triggers, exchanging the text boxes of itself and Wormfang Manta.
Activate Elrond by paying {5}{U}{U}, exiling and returning (at end step) Exchange of Words.
When Exchange of Words leaves the battlefield, its ability from Wormfang Manta's textbox triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
When Exchange of Words enters, it triggers, exchanging the text boxes of itself and Wormfang Manta.
Repeat from step 3 each turn.

608-2022-2034-5495-7824.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
It is your turn.
608-2022-2034-5495-7824.description:
Activate Thallid Soothsayer by paying {2} and sacrificing another creature, causing you to draw a card.
An opponent's Wedding Ring's second ability triggers, causing them to draw a card.
Xyris' first ability triggers, creating two 1/1 Snake creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Snake, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

1496-1895-4399-4770.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Pearl Medallion.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Verdant Sun's Avatar triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Verdant Sun's Avatar trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Verdant Sun's Avatar trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
1496-1895-4399-4770.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

343-2092-4954.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Regal Behemoth triggers, adding {1}.
Activate Silvanus's Invoker by paying {1}, untapping the land and causing it to become an 8/8 Elemental with trample and haste in addition to its other types until end of turn.
Repeat.
343-2092-4954.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may tap and untap any other land(s) you control, and use the mana to activate Agatha of the Vile Cauldron's ability.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2438-6972-7235.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Stag Beetle.
When Stag Beetle dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

3967-5170-5933-6132.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Popular Egotist triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Popular Egotist trigger.
Resolve the Popular Egotist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

1978-3043-5143.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures with defender.
1978-3043-5143.description:
Activate Axebane Guardian by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Axebane Guardian.
Repeat

1734-3817-6798.description:
Cast Fiend Hunter by paying its mana cost.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sister Hospitaller.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Fiend Hunter.
When Fiend Hunter dies, its second ability triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from exile to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sister Hospitaller.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat from step 3.

2173-3967-4336-5220.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Kobolds of Kher Keep
When Kobolds of Kher Keep dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Kobolds of Kher Keep from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

969-2105-6911.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Combat Celebrant has vigilance.
969-2105-6911.description:
Declare Combat Celebrant as an attacker, choosing to exert it as it attacks and triggering its ability, causing you to untap all other creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Combat Celebrant, triggering Impostor Syndrome, creating a token copy of Combat Celebrant that isn't legendary.
During your next combat phase, declare Combat Celebrant and the Combat Celebrant token as attackers, choosing to exert the Combat Celebrant token as it attacks.
The Combat Celebrant token triggers, causing you to untap all other creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2.

1681-4140-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Twilight Shepherd.
When Twilight Shepherd dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Giada.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

1339-4279-6752.notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
You control at least one additional creature.
1339-4279-6752.description:
Activate Yawgmoth's first ability by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature, causing you to draw a card and allowing you to put a -1/-1 counter on up to one creature.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Haliya triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

1981-4416-4476-6740.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 3.
You control two untapped Soldiers.
1981-4416-4476-6740.description:
Declare Phyrexian Vindicator as an attacker.
Holding priority, activate Catapult Squad by tapping two Soldiers, attempting to deal 2 damage to Phyrexian Vindicator.
The damage is prevented due to Phyrexian Vindicator's replacement effect. Phyrexian Vindicator triggers, dealing 2 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating two 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
When the Soldiers enter the battlefield, Answered Prayers triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat from step 2.

2665-3362.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Progenitor Mimic
2665-3362.description:
Cast Progenitor Mimic by paying its mana cost, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Bladewing.
Put Bladewing into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Progenitor Mimic's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, returning Bladewing from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Put Bladewing into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Bladewing's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

5043-5078-5231-5243.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Alela triggers, creating a 1/1 Faerie creature token.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Faerie, adding {R}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Repeat.

2018-3216-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Suncleanser.
When Suncleanser dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Suncleanser from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
When Suncleanser enters the battlefield, it triggers, removing the flying counter from Suncleanser.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

2793-4779-5483.description:
During your end step, activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Ugin's Nexus.
Ugin's Nexus is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Esoteric Duplicator triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Ugin's Nexus at the beginning of your next end step.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability.
Move to your extra turn.
At the beginning of your end step, Esoteric Duplicator triggers, creating a token copy of Ugin's Nexus.
Repeat.

567-1116-3240-5670.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
567-1116-3240-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by sacrificing Nether Traitor and paying 1 life.
When Nether Traitor dies, Sek'Kuar triggers, creating a 3/1 Graveborn creature token.
When the Graveborn enters the battlefield, Soul's Attendant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the Graveborn.
When the Graveborn dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Nether Traitor enters the battlefield, Soul's Attendant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat.

2178-4050-4147-4215.easyPrerequisites: Thornbite Staff attached to Hua Tuo.
2178-4050-4147-4215.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional nontoken green creature.
Hua Tuo does not have summoning sickness.
2178-4050-4147-4215.description:
During your precombat main phase, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the additional nontoken green creature, adding one mana of any color.
When the creature dies, Verdant Succession and Hua Tuo trigger.
Holding priority, activate Hua Tuo by tapping it, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Hua Tuo trigger from step 2, untapping it.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for the sacrificed creature and putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

3000-3641-5670.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
3000-3641-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature, creating a Treasure token and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Distinguished Conjurer triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

586-4050-4790-5149.notablePrerequisites: Power Artifact attached to Dino DNA.
586-4050-4790-5149.description:
Activate Dino DNA by paying {4}, creating a token copy of Priest of Gix that is a 6/6 Dinosaur.
When the Priest of Gix token enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Priest of Gix token, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2564-3603-4231-4823.description:
Cast Cloudshift by paying {W}, blinking Timeless Witness.
When Timeless Witness enters the battlefield, it and Lonis trigger.
Resolve the Timeless Witness trigger, returning Cloudshift from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Lonis trigger, creating a Food, a Clue, and a Treasure artifact token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Repeat.

643-1147-2034.description:
Cast Grovetender Druids by paying {2}{G}{W}.
When Grovetender Druids enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Plant creature token.
When the Plant enters the battlefield as an Ally due to Maskwood Nexus, Grovetender Druids triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Plant, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Grovetender Druids trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Plant creature token.
Repeat from step 3.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Plants.

1601-2816-5003.notablePrerequisites:
You control a nontoken creature with mana value eight or greater.
Illuminor Szeras does not have summoning sickness.
Umbral Mantle attached to Illuminor Szeras.
1601-2816-5003.description:
Activate Illuminor Szeras by tapping it and sacrificing another creature with mana value eight or greater, adding at least eight {B}.
When the creature dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Activate Illuminor Szeras by paying {3} and untapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.
